course_name_original: Fundamentos de la Ingeniería de Fabricación
prerequisites: Mathematics: Logarithms, Differential and integral calculus, Geometry, Plane trigonometry
Physics, especially a broad command of classical Mechanics

Technical drawing, especially the execution, reading and interpretation of drawings, with all that this entails (generation of views, dimensioning, drawing and representation standards, handling and interpretation of tolerances, etc.)
Manufacturing processes, at the level of the subject taught in second-year Engineering Degrees (Tolerances, manufacturing processes, analysis of their parameters, etc.)

learning_outcomes.text: Plan the manufacturing processes of mechatronic system components, considering the restrictions imposed by the manufacturing, assembly, and verification environment.
Select the material, dimension and optimize the shape of the elements of mechatronic systems, taking into account criteria of resistance, durability and reliability.
Incorporate the necessary electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic sensors and actuators based on the characteristics of the mechatronic system, its specifications and its integration with it.
Identify the subcomponents of a technologically complex system, the interactions between them, and the effects and consequences of their possible redesign.
Justify in a well-founded manner the different options for the automation of a mechatronic type machine or technological process.
Interpret and elaborate the necessary information to manufacture and verify a product
Relate, select and calculate the main parameters of various manufacturing processes
Create manufacturing plans, considering machine type, operations to be performed, tools, process parameters
Write numerical control programs for part manufacturing
Select instruments and verification processes for parts based on the geometric characteristics of the parts and their tolerances

Select measuring instruments and verification processes, relating their characteristics and metrological status (precision, uncertainty, calibration status, etc.) with the metrological requirements of the measurement to be performed
Ensure the traceability of the measurements made
Modify the part planning and the numerical control program, based on the results obtained and measured
Know the mechanical and control elements of a machine tool, and the interactions between them

syllabus_topics: Selection and calculation of cutting parameters

assessment_methods.method: Practical knowledge: results of laboratory practices and their proper execution
Practical knowledge: documentation provided for practices and other proposed works
Practical knowledge: ability to justify decisions and present and defend works

assessment_rules: To pass the course, students must achieve a global score equal to or greater than 50% of the maximum possible score. It is essential that students achieve at least 50% of the score in each of the two parts (theoretical-practical and practical knowledge). If the minimum in one part is not achieved, the overall grade will be a fail, and numerically will be that of the part with the lowest score. The grade for the practical knowledge part will be maintained in the calls of the same enrollment unless the minimum of 50% is not reached, in which case the student will be obliged to repeat the practical work deemed necessary by the professor or to substitute them with a written exam, always at the discretion of the professor.
